title: New SPYS interceptor shot down Russia’s Geran-5 cruise missile
big: 67 new stories. The new stories are led by space; the top five are about drones, capital markets, allies, ships, missiles and munitions.

stories.h: New SPYS interceptor shot down Russia’s Geran-5 cruise missile
stories.what: A Ukrainian-built interceptor drone has destroyed a Geran-5 K5-K, a weapon widely reported as Russia's newest jet-powered attack drone but classed by Ukrainian intelligence as a small cruise missile.
stories.you: The next buy is more of the Ukrainian interceptor that destroyed Geran-5.

stories.h: Turkish naval gun system shoots down jet drone in live-fire test
stories.what: A Turkish twin-cannon ship defense system shot down a fast jet-powered drone off Türkiye's northern coast, and its operator only had to press one button. ASELSAN released video of the test on Monday.

stories.h: China’s fourth aircraft carrier, bigger than others and nuclear-powered, nears completion
stories.what: NEW TAIPEI CITY, Taiwan — China's fourth aircraft carrier, a gigantic vessel known so far as just Type 004, will come out as early as next year bigger than its predecessors and with nuclear power that can launch planes faster than usual in case of any…

stories.h: Amentum Reports $13.8B in FY2026 Revenue, $48.3B Backlog
stories.what: Amentum secured $15 billion in net bookings, including major NGA, Navy, Army and international nuclear program awards.
stories.you: The backlog positions Amentum to win the next awards from the Navy, the Army, NGA and nuclear.

stories.h: U.S. Commits $2B Defense Loan for Philippine Military, Luzon Strait Development
stories.what: MANILA, Philippines — The U.S. pledged to grant a $2 billion foreign military financing loan package for Manila's military modernization efforts and the development of an airport in the Luzon Strait.
stories.you: The loan for Luzon Strait sets up buys for the Philippine military.

watch.h: Stopgap funding expires: FY27 appropriations or another CR

idea.h: Synthetic data and test & evaluation for autonomy
idea.why: Simulation and synthetic sensor data to train and certify autonomy when GPS is denied and radios are jammed. New autonomy policy (the June 2026 memo, CSIS definitions) means systems need verification evidence, and the new command gets test powers.
